d: Short, teal-colored hair with choppy layers and a single curved strand protruding from the top. Sharp, almond-shaped eyes of a matching teal shade set in a youthful, adolescent face with a slight smile. A slender build wearing a black sleeveless vest over a white long-sleeved collared shirt, paired with a black pleated skirt, white knee-high socks, and black boots. A large, flowing teal and black cape with a diamond-patterned lining drapes over one shoulder, complemented by a black crossbody strap and a handheld black digital tablet.
